Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/chat/middleware/types.ts:469](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/chat/middleware/types.ts#L469)

Decision returned from onBeforeToolCall.
- undefined/void: continue with normal execution
- { type: 'transformArgs', args }: replace args used for execution
- { type: 'skip', result }: skip execution, use provided result
- { type: 'abort', reason }: abort the entire chat run

#### metadata?

```ts
optional metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
```

Optional result metadata for the app. The model never sees it. The
tool does not run, so the result gets only this metadata. The value
is not checked against the tool schema.
